2.web: “Bear with me a little, and I will show you; for I still have something to say on God’s behalf.
2.asv: Suffer me a little, and I will show thee; For I have yet somewhat to say on God’s behalf.

3.web: I will get my knowledge from afar, and will ascribe righteousness to my Maker.
3.asv: I will fetch my knowledge from afar, And will ascribe righteousness to my Maker.

4.web: For truly my words are not false. One who is perfect in knowledge is with you.
4.asv: For truly my words are not false: One that is perfect in knowledge is with thee.

5.web: “Behold, God is mighty, and doesn’t despise anyone. He is mighty in strength of understanding.
5.asv: Behold, God is mighty, and despiseth not any: He is mighty in strength of understanding.

6.web: He doesn’t preserve the life of the wicked, but gives to the afflicted their right.
6.asv: He preserveth not the life of the wicked, But giveth to the afflicted their right.

7.web: He doesn’t withdraw his eyes from the righteous, but with kings on the throne, he sets them forever, and they are exalted.
7.asv: He withdraweth not his eyes from the righteous: But with kings upon the throne He setteth them for ever, and they are exalted.

8.web: If they are bound in fetters, and are taken in the cords of afflictions,
8.asv: And if they be bound in fetters, And be taken in the cords of affliction;

9.web: then he shows them their work, and their transgressions, that they have behaved themselves proudly.
9.asv: Then he showeth them their work, And their transgressions, that they have behaved themselves proudly.

10.web: He also opens their ears to instruction, and commands that they return from iniquity.
10.asv: He openeth also their ear to instruction, And commandeth that they return from iniquity.

11.web: If they listen and serve him, they shall spend their days in prosperity, and their years in pleasures.
11.asv: If they hearken and serve him, They shall spend their days in prosperity, And their years in pleasures.

12.web: But if they don’t listen, they shall perish by the sword; they shall die without knowledge.
12.asv: But if they hearken not, they shall perish by the sword, And they shall die without knowledge.

13.web: “But those who are godless in heart lay up anger. They don’t cry for help when he binds them.
13.asv: But they that are godless in heart lay up anger: They cry not for help when he bindeth them.

14.web: They die in youth. Their life perishes among the unclean.
14.asv: They die in youth, And their lifeperisheth among the unclean.

15.web: He delivers the afflicted by their affliction, and opens their ear in oppression.
15.asv: He delivereth the afflicted by their affliction, And openeth their ear in oppression.

16.web: Yes, he would have allured you out of distress, into a broad place, where there is no restriction. That which is set on your table would be full of fatness.
16.asv: Yea, he would have allured thee out of distress Into a broad place, where there is no straitness; And that which is set on thy table would be full of fatness.

17.web: “But you are full of the judgment of the wicked. Judgment and justice take hold of you.
17.asv: But thou art full of the judgment of the wicked: Judgment and justice take holdon thee.

18.web: Don’t let riches entice you to wrath, neither let the great size of a bribe turn you aside.
18.asv: For let not wrath stir thee up against chastisements; Neither let the greatness of the ransom turn thee aside.

19.web: Would your wealth sustain you in distress, or all the might of your strength?
19.asv: Will thy cry avail, that thou be not in distress, Or all the forces ofthystrength?

20.web: Don’t desire the night, when people are cut off in their place.
20.asv: Desire not the night, When peoples are cut off in their place.

21.web: Take heed, don’t regard iniquity; for you have chosen this rather than affliction.
21.asv: Take heed, regard not iniquity: For this hast thou chosen rather than affliction.

22.web: Behold, God is exalted in his power. Who is a teacher like him?
22.asv: Behold, God doeth loftily in his power: Who is a teacher like unto him?

23.web: Who has prescribed his way for him? Or who can say, ‘You have committed unrighteousness?’
23.asv: Who hath enjoined him his way? Or who can say, Thou hast wrought unrighteousness?

24.web: “Remember that you magnify his work, whereof men have sung.
24.asv: Remember that thou magnify his work, Whereof men have sung.

25.web: All men have looked on it. Man sees it afar off.
25.asv: All men have looked thereon; Man beholdeth it afar off.

26.web: Behold, God is great, and we don’t know him. The number of his years is unsearchable.
26.asv: Behold, God is great, and we know him not; The number of his years is unsearchable.

27.web: For he draws up the drops of water, which distill in rain from his vapor,
27.asv: For he draweth up the drops of water, Which distil in rain from his vapor,

28.web: Which the skies pour down and which drop on man abundantly.
28.asv: Which the skies pour down And drop upon man abundantly.

29.web: Yes, can any understand the spreading of the clouds, and the thunderings of his pavilion?
29.asv: Yea, can any understand the spreadings of the clouds, The thunderings of his pavilion?

30.web: Behold, he spreads his light around him. He covers the bottom of the sea.
30.asv: Behold, he spreadeth his light around him; And he covereth the bottom of the sea.

31.web: For by these he judges the people. He gives food in abundance.
31.asv: For by these he judgeth the peoples; He giveth food in abundance.

32.web: He covers his hands with the lightning, and commands it to strike the mark.
32.asv: He covereth his hands with the lightning, And giveth it a charge that it strike the mark.

33.web: Its noise tells about him, and the livestock also concerning the storm that comes up.
33.asv: The noise thereof telleth concerning him, The cattle also concerningthe stormthat cometh up.
